subject: Insurance
title: The Driving Score Revolution
description: A fast breakdown of The Driving Score Revolution for builders.

hook.text: A tiny device in your car tracks every brake, turn, and acceleration.

buildup.text: Telematics devices or smartphone apps record speed, braking force, cornering, time of day, and distance driven.

discovery.text: Safe drivers save 10-40% on premiums. Aggressive drivers pay more.

twist.text: Privacy vanishes. Your insurer knows when you drive, how fast, and where you stop.

climax.text: Telematics replaces group pricing with individual pricing. You pay for your own risk, not your age group's risk.

punchline.text: Every brake, tracked. Every turn, scored. Your premium updates live.

quiz.question: How much can safe drivers save with telematics insurance?
